# Aydin Kalantar

> Aydin Kalantar is a product designer and developer based in Mayfield Heights, Ohio, USA, who designs and builds AI products and creates hand-cut natural wood veneer marquetry art. The family name is also written Kalantarov, Kalantarli and Kalan; these all refer to the same person.

- Name: Aydin Kalantar (also Aydin Kalantarov, Aydin Kalantarli, Aydin Kalan)
- Role: Product designer, developer, marquetry artist
- Location: Mayfield Heights, Ohio, USA
- Phone: +1 216-339-8948
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aydin-kalantar

## Products

- [The Best Screen Printing website](https://aydinkalantar.com/case-studies/tbsp/): 2026 rebuild of thebestscreenprinting.com for a Los Angeles screen printing and embroidery shop: buy-online catalog with design placement, Max voice merch agent, and a data-driven WordPress SEO migration. Live at https://thebestscreenprinting.com
- [Virtual Fashion](https://aydinkalantar.com/case-studies/virtual-fashion/): AI apparel design studio for generating on-model product photos and video. Live at https://virtualfashion.app
- [Catch Lead](https://aydinkalantar.com/case-studies/catch-lead/): AI chat and voice sales agent that answers website visitors 24/7, qualifies leads and books appointments for service businesses. Live at https://catchlead.dev
- [Auto Alpha](https://aydinkalantar.com/case-studies/auto-alpha/): Crypto trading strategy automation. Live at https://autoalpha.trade

## Craft

- [Marquetry art gallery](https://aydinkalantar.com/art/): Original portraits, abstract pieces and commissions in natural wood veneer, cut and fitted by hand. Formerly at art.aydinkalantar.com.

## Earlier work

- Graphic design, 3D modeling and rendering.
- 2017 to 2020, Los Angeles: branding, web design and development, SEO, Google Ads and Facebook Ads for The Best Screen Printing (https://thebestscreenprinting.com) and Signs Market (https://signsmarket.com). In 2026 Aydin rebuilt The Best Screen Printing website (case study above).
